blocks.text: A ferritin blood test measures the level of ferritin in blood. Ferritin is a protein inside cells that stores iron.
Ferritin releases iron when the body needs it. A ferritin test can show how much iron is stored in the body.
A provider may order a ferritin test as part of a group of iron tests.
